description: A tall, pale room at the bottom of the spine, the ceiling pinched down to meet the lift doors. A desk, an empty bench, and fifteen brass floor numbers set in a line in the stone from the door to the lift, polished. Usually empty.

window.description: Curved glass either side of the entrance hood, out onto the corner where Sorrel Way meets the mews. From the desk you see everybody who comes past and almost nobody comes past.
window.name: the hood glazing

name: Long Lease — The Entrance Hall
